text: Why don't these drugs work on calcified PTSD? Because even if they did work for mood by modulating serotonin transmission, PTSD is not a mood disorder. That's a bit like putting some Bengay on a broken leg. This protocol tries to get at the underpinnings of the problem. The ketone BHB blocks enzymes called HDACs (Shimazu, et al, 2013), and in mice that couldn't hold on to extinction learning (learning that a cue is now safe), an HDAC blocker made the new learning last (Whittle & Singewald, 2014). In people with PTSD, the first small study of a keto diet with BHB supplements found that both people who finished its four weeks improved, by 20 and 10 points on the standard 80-point PTSD checklist, which its authors call clinically meaningful (Edwards, et al, 2024). In two case reports, women whose PTSD hadn't responded to treatment were nearly or fully free of symptoms after months on the diet (Bellamy & Laurent, 2025; Laurent, 2026). No controlled trial of the diet has been done yet, and the one placebo-controlled trial of BHB supplements alone was too small to tell either way (Youssef, et al, 2022).
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what

checked.point: whether ketosis does that in people hasn't been tested
checked.found: true of the HDAC route, but ketosis has been tried in people with PTSD: a four-week keto diet with BHB salts, PCL-5 down 20 and 10 points in the two who finished (Edwards et al. 2024); two case reports, PCL-5 80 to 0 at 12 weeks and 32 to 2 at 27 weeks (Bellamy and Laurent 2025; Laurent 2026)
checked.still_needed: yes: they learn what has been seen when people with PTSD tried ketosis, in place of a sentence that reads as if it never had been

checked.point: how far the human evidence goes
checked.found: no controlled trial of the diet (the registered studies are single-arm: NCT05415982, NCT07415590); a 2026 integrative review finds only minimal reliable information from human studies; the one placebo-controlled trial of BHB salts found no difference between its groups with 21 people, which its authors put down to its size (Youssef et al. 2022)
checked.still_needed: yes: they take the human results as early signs, not proof
